'''Jubba nuts'''<ref name="Wildlife">''[[The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide]]''</ref> were the small [[Nut/Legends|nuts]] of the [[jubba]] [[Plant/Legends|plant]], which was [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Forest/Legends|forest]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. They were considered a delicacy by the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]]<ref name="CSWE" /> [[Species/Legends|species]] who were also native to Endor. The nuts were the same size as the small [[Brain/Legends|brain]] of the [[Blurrg/Legends|blurrg]], a species of [[Reptile/Legends|reptile]] found on Endor that was known for its simple intelligence.<ref name="Wildlife" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jubba nuts were first mentioned in the [[2001]] reference book ''[[The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide]]'', which was written by [[Terryl Whitlatch]].<ref name="Wildlife">''[[The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide]]''</ref>
